relations.subject: Ram Chandra Kak
relations.evidence: Kak graduated from Sri Pratap College in 1913 and enrolled for a M. A., before being selected for training in archaeology.

relations.subject: Ram Chandra Kak
relations.evidence: From 1914 to 1919, Kak trained under John Marshall.

relations.subject: Ram Chandra Kak
relations.evidence: After training, Kak was appointed as the superintendent of the newly established Department of Archaeology, before being promoted to the Director.
